guides.source_note: Rules of thumb used in residential furniture planning: about 24 in is a tight single-file squeeze, 30 in is comfortable, 36 in is generous and the usual allowance in front of a dresser for opening drawers and standing. For reference, 36 in is also the US International Residential Code minimum hallway width (IRC R311.6). These are guides, not code requirements for bedrooms.
guides.note_shallowest_miles_dresser: Every Miles dresser in West Elm's US line is 18 in deep or more (60, 70: 18; 34: 18.3; 48 narrow and 49 wide: 19.3), so no Miles dresser on the west wall widens the aisle.

measurements_requested: East window: from the north wall to the north end of the sill (stool) and to the outer edge of the trim (estimates 80.3 and 81.3 in), and how far the sill sticks out from the wall (estimate 2 in). This decides whether the queen headboard sits flat to the wall.
North nightstand width (estimate 17 in, Daniel says about 18).
On the west wall: from the north wall to the white door's trim (estimate 58.9) and to its hinge edge (62.15 to 62.9), and how far the north window's sill sticks out.
Clear room width from west wall to east wall at about 30 in high.
Whether the white door and the closet door must open fully, and what is behind the white door.

main_route.note: measured with doors in their everyday state; below 20 is invalid; 24 tight, 30 comfortable, 36 generous are rules of thumb; IRC R311.6 36-in hallway is a reference only

bed_side_strip.note: width of the strip beside each long side of the bed, measured on its own (the destination, not a route through it); 18 tight, 24 comfortable

brief_minimums.body_model: routes use floor-level obstacles (anything from the floor to 24 in high) plus anything above 24 in that projects more than 3 in from the wall; window stools and casings projecting 3 in or less do not narrow routes (people pass them), but still count for furniture collisions

drawer_standing.report: standing space in front of a fully open drawer, one drawer at a time

brief_minimums.doors: white door and closet door: at least 90 degrees (a piece may be the stop); entry door: fully open to the south wall. Report each resting angle.

other.drawer_extension_basis: Quality 13.5-inch published interior depth used as conservative extension scenario, value14-inch scenario; physical full extension not published.
other.storage: Quality five drawers plus closet; value four drawers plus closet. Today has nine cubes, not equivalent drawers; no false drawer-volume comparison.
other.worst_case_note: Room metrology not tape-verified. Primary gap varies about +/-1.5 inches with room width; guest desk zone varies about +/-3 inches with depth. Tape before order; a nominal fit is not an as-built guarantee.

geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.
geometry_script.exclusions: Rug under furniture, mattress on bed, wall art, curtains behind furniture and lamp atop nightstand are intentional vertical layers. Nook tabletop above seat is allowed; base is checked separately.

rental_checks.notes: Primary bathroom often closed; report its open state separately. Existing rolling laundry sorter removed under rental start-empty instruction, superseding owner-use brief. Mattress/slat compatibility, tip restraint fixings and actual finished mattress height need assembly checks.
assembly_gates: Install required anti-tip restraints before letting (primary chest).
Measure assembled mattress top: target23.25–26.25 inches, so nightstand is never above mattress. Slat spacing/load and warranty-for-rental not independently certified.
GRUSNARV is fitted waterproof protection, not a zippered encasement; full bedbug encasement remains an optional unsourced procurement upgrade.
Test sealed blackout peel-away and normal exterior-opening operation; do not obstruct bedroom escape.
rental_checks.glass_policy_interpretation: No glass furniture, lamp shades, vessels or picture glazing. Required functional safety-backed wall mirrors and TV display are not mirrored furniture; neither is freestanding/leaning. Obtain owner clarification if literal no-glass includes required functional mirror.

layouts.rationale: Narrow chest preserves usable door opening and makes this a restful sleep room, not an overfilled furniture set. Five quality drawers or four value drawers supplement existing closet; drawer volume not equated to Today’s open cubes.

styling.warranty: Limited lifetime; >1.5 inch visible indentation; first 10 years non-prorated, then 50%/60%/75% replacement charges in years 11-15/16-20/21+. Normal softening excluded; rental eligibility not affirmatively established.

trial.note: Eligibility/return fees and minimum break-in apply; retail trial is not a proven rental-use guarantee. Brooklyn cached FAQ/JSON-LD still says 120 nights/$99 fee while live page says 365; get current terms before relying on it.

durability_evidence.evidence_type: Sleep Foundation hands-on tests support medium-firm feel and value; current design lacks a multi-year rental cohort.

cooling.basis: Ventilated/coil construction and/or cooling cover; copper benefit is manufacturer marketing, not germ-control protection. No guarantee of cool sleep under waterproof layers.

layouts.hero_view: From hall entry at southwest corner, camera 50 inches high, looking northeast: low timber headboard, paired lamps, clay duvet and unblocked north/east glass.
layouts.rationale: Warm oak/acorn, Sedona percale and one desert-art pair carry the scheme; walnut quality bed deliberately bridges the cognac living room instead of unverified upholstered Miles fabric. Bare oak floors are intentional: no unverified non-washable rug. Closet complements drawers; no current furniture retained.
removes: All existing movable furniture; no reuse assumed.

hand_checks.method: Executable Python rectangle/SAT audit against exact room JSON; quarter-degree one-sided door-leaf sweeps; explicit analytic corridor/ellipse calculations. Survey, not tape-verified.

other.doors_everyday: Entry90 open; bathroom and closet closed.

hard_rules: Waterproof fitted mattress protectors are included, but a live purchasable zip-on encasement was not verified; zip-on standard remains unmet.
rental_checks.notes: North side 16.75in is below24in comfort, but above15in calibrated hard minimum. Bathroom leaf at90 degrees leaves 13.875in; it is usually closed, and the wider resting angle is reported separately. Nightstand top vs mattress not certified: measure mattress-support deck. Quality nightstand24 requires mattress top24–27; value23.25 requires23.25–26.25. Primary closet depth and hanger/shelf inventory are not measured; compact chest complements it.
rental_checks.fabric_policy: No velvet, bouclé, white seating, glass-top or marble furniture. Functional safety-backed wall mirrors and electronic displays are not mirrored furniture. Removable bedding and shade fabric are not seat upholstery.

layouts.cost_basis: USD public item prices as checked 2026-11-17; quantity is purchase units, including full packs. Excludes tax, shipping, assembly, hemming and electrical installation; not a delivered quote.

cooling.basis: Ventilated/coil construction and/or cooling cover; copper benefit is manufacturer marketing, not germ-control protection. No guarantee of cool sleep under waterproof layers.

geometry_script.method: Python: nominal room bounds, pairwise exact AABB checks; 0.25-degree swept thin door rectangles tested by separating-axis theorem; .5-inch-grid widest disk path for routes. Door states separate. No generic unverified footprint substituted for a purchasable product.

guides.source_note: Rules of thumb used in residential furniture planning: about 24 in is a tight single-file squeeze, 30 in is comfortable, 36 in is generous and the usual allowance in front of a dresser for opening drawers and standing. For reference, 36 in is also the US International Residential Code minimum hallway width (IRC R311.6). These are guides, not code requirements for bedrooms.
guides.note_shallowest_miles_dresser: Every Miles dresser in West Elm's US line is 18 in deep or more (60, 70: 18; 34: 18.3; 48 narrow and 49 wide: 19.3), so no Miles dresser on the west wall widens the aisle.

measurements_requested: East window: from the north wall to the north end of the sill (stool) and to the outer edge of the trim (estimates 80.3 and 81.3 in), and how far the sill sticks out from the wall (estimate 2 in). This decides whether the queen headboard sits flat to the wall.
North nightstand width (estimate 17 in, Daniel says about 18).
On the west wall: from the north wall to the white door's trim (estimate 58.9) and to its hinge edge (62.15 to 62.9), and how far the north window's sill sticks out.
Clear room width from west wall to east wall at about 30 in high.
Whether the white door and the closet door must open fully, and what is behind the white door.
